description: The life-manager-loop portion of FIND-015/FIND-016 is NOT resolved, only partially compensated. life-manager-loop-healthcheck.sh intentionally leaves HC_OUTPUT unset (documented at lines 3-4: 'revenue truth is verified by verify-loops.sh'), so healthcheck-lib.sh's case (d) artifact-vs-marker check (the mechanism that makes FIND-015 true for capafy/reddit) never runs for LM -- meaning a self-fix or a STEP2 pass that falsely claims 'fixed the funnel, revenue growing' for LM has NO automated real-artifact check anywhere in the codebase. verify-loops-audit.sh (the compensating control) only ever computes LM's HEARTBEAT staleness (stale_hrs "$LMHB", i.e. .life-manager-loop-last-pass, which is touched unconditionally by the STARTUP cron prompt every pass regardless of outcome) -- it never reads lm_mrr_usd from life-manager-loop/state/STATE.md nor calls Stripe itself, despite verify-loops.sh:32's own text implying 'revenue via Stripe verify' happens. Additionally, verify-loops-audit.sh:24 has an independent bug: `LM_NOTE="...LM last-pass stale ${LMHB}"` interpolates $LMHB, which is the FILE PATH string ($HOME/.openclaw/state/.life-manager-loop-last-pass), not the computed staleness-hours from stale_hrs("$LMHB") -- so even the one LM signal this audit does surface renders as a useless/misleading path string instead of an hours count in the report channel message.
